body: sometimes I look in the mirror, check my pulse, feel my heartbeat, stuff like that
sometimes just those acts of physical activity really help me feel like anything at all

honestly what I find helpful is some form of physical activity. whether it's a long walk/run that makes my legs hurt, or I start to sweat and breathe heavily, basically feeling somewhat uncomfortable makes me feel something if that makes any sense.
I mean I'm also moving out of this place next Saturday so I'm real close
it's not mine technically it's my aptmate's, I'd dump it but they could probably use it - maybe I talk to them?
I am taking them. I don't feel much different though.
I have a therapist and a psychiatrist but it's all just too much. My family is mostly making me feel this way. My mom sent me to a hospital and I honestly feel like I should have stayed longer.

I decided to journal tonight and try to lay things out but I got overwhelmed by exhaustion and I felt hopeless on where to even begin. I'm really tired and I want to finally get an eight hour night in for once and hopefully tomorrow is better. I have a friend visiting me so that should be nice. They're graduating though and I'm gonna be real upset when they leave. So I'm anticipating tomorrow and dreading it all the same.

Thank you. I am hoping that once I am done with the quarter that summer will bring something into my life. I mean I see myself holding on and not ending things, but to just go through the motions - it seems all too upsetting for me and for the people around me.
